This release moves the firmware's nRF Connect SDK base from v3.4.0 to
v3.4.1. No application source changed; every shipped preset builds
unchanged on the new SDK.

**Two SoftDevice Controller defects are fixed by the move:**

- **DRGN-29459** — a CS Reflector shifted the CS tone phase incorrectly when
  IPT was used with multiple antenna paths. Every IPT reflector image this
  repository builds uses four paths, so the firmware released before this
  one is affected.
- **DRGN-29669** — the controller could assert when an ACL connection with
  active CS procedures disconnected during a scheduling conflict.

**IPT reflector phase behavior changed.** IPT-reflector captures taken on
pre-v3.4.1 firmware are invalid for phase, PCT, range, and angle work: the
phase they contain carries the DRGN-29459 error, so re-capture with this
release before drawing such conclusions. The same captures remain valid for
link, framing, rate, and payload conclusions. RAS captures are unaffected by
the fix and stay comparable across the migration.

**Nothing your tooling depends on moved.** Image names, preset names, and
the COBS wire format are unchanged, so pinned scripts and host tooling need
no update.

Validation basis: the release workflow's build job compiles every shipped
preset for both roles on the v3.4.1 toolchain container, and the DK bench
discriminator holds the initiator fixed while swapping only the L15
reflector — first the v1.17.0 image, then this release — for RAS and IPT.
RAS is checked to stay unchanged within run-to-run noise; IPT is checked to
show the phase correction.
